entries.528be2a704ad129e: This is the core business of the Group, in which metal and plastic products purchased from material makers and peer companies are held in the factory as standard stock items and, upon order, cut or milled and delivered on short lead times. Products not kept in stock are sold as made-to-order products delivered directly to customers from material makers or peer companies. The business consists of three reportable segments by location (Japan, North America and China) and other regions.
